title: Super Cup ATTP – Autumn 2024: second stage “Children’s Dream”
excerpt: Super Cup ATTP – Autumn 2024: second stage “Children’s Dream”
body_html:
On 30 November 2024, TOP CUP Academy hosted the prestigious children’s stage of the table tennis competition — Super Cup ATTP – AUTUMN 2024.

Competitions held under the auspices of ATTP give young amateurs and talented beginners the chance to measure themselves against the best players in the country, building experience and confidence for the challenges ahead.

This exceptional project of the National Sports Association ATTP, a fine initiative now in its 6th edition, inspires hundreds of children to play table tennis, to grow and to stay healthy.

Super Cup ATTP is more than a project — it is a nationwide effort that confirms the power of table tennis to shape children’s futures. With the support of development partners, ATTP’s mission came into sharp focus at today’s special event, the AUTUMN 2024 edition, which brought together more than 150 young table tennis enthusiasts from every region of the country.

The wholehearted support of the entire table tennis community of the Republic of Moldova and the joint effort of the young players turned this Super Cup ATTP edition into a historic event for Moldovan sport!

The children’s fantastic performances in the second stage of the tournament are important proof for home table tennis, showing that the Republic of Moldova continues to develop talent capable of performing at the highest level.
